en: Color postcard showing a large, stone, domed former mosque with small arched windows, now topped by a cross, situated on a stepped square with flower beds, lawns, and benches in the foreground and several mid‑20th‑century cars parked along the steps. The reverse side has multilingual printed captions identifying the place and standard postcard layout for address and stamp.
